claim_boundary: No cross-family sample-efficiency claim is permitted unless physical-cycle, calibration, and labeled-training budgets are matched explicitly.
The validation-trained linear logistic effect is the named predeclared non-oracle comparator; matched analytic witnesses and exact likelihood ratios are model-aware controls or ceilings.

A positive comparison flag requires both the distribution-free simultaneous confidence bound and Holm-adjusted one-sided test to pass for both preregistered middle-effect hypotheses, with the ARL guarantee intact.
A pass supports only vAOC versus the named logistic comparator on these two controlled tasks; it is not a strongest-baseline, general algorithmic-advantage, or universal sample-efficiency result.
No superiority to Helstrom, a Wilson oracle, an exact likelihood ratio, or a threshold/logistic rule on the identical sufficient statistic is claimed.

No quantum acceleration, universal sample efficiency, scalable computational advantage, new topological-order theorem, Wilson-loop discovery, string-theory result, or holographic-duality result is claimed.
config.design_provenance: Cycle-fair locked design frozen after the reduced pilot and independent pre-freeze audit, before the publication-grade sequential test. The audit corrected a temporal pair-versus-cycle unit error, separated every validation/training seed from locked-test seeds, and added a named validation-trained linear logistic comparator plus a multiplicity-controlled primary comparison. This comparator was chosen after inspecting the independent offline diagnostic audit but before any sequential locked test; it is predeclared here rather than claimed to be the strongest generic baseline. No publication-grade sequential result was inspected before this v2 design was frozen.
config.name: run5-paper-locked-v2-cycle-fair

primary_comparison_hypotheses.estimand: paired restart-at-change restricted mean delay difference in physical cycles: proposed minus baseline
primary_comparison_hypotheses.required_decision: For each hypothesis, the distribution-free Bonferroni-Hoeffding simultaneous 95% upper bound must be below zero and the Holm-adjusted one-sided Hoeffding p-value must be below 0.05. Overall comparison support additionally requires both hypotheses to pass. A pass supports only vAOC versus this named comparator on the two declared tasks.

config.seed_partition_note: Calibration, labeled-comparator training, ridge validation, locked spatial tests, locked temporal tests, scaling, timing, and descriptive bootstrap use explicitly disjoint seed partitions; load_config verifies every sampling interval before execution.

units.detector_thresholds: detector updates; 1000 spatial updates and 500 temporal pair updates both correspond to a target ARL of at least 1000 physical cycles
units.temporal_detector_update: one nonoverlapping pair = two physical syndrome cycles

validation_trained_baseline.budget_note: Both families receive 4096 labeled physical cycles per class. The temporal arm necessarily has half as many nonoverlapping pair updates; no cross-family sample-efficiency comparison is made.
